entities.name: Web Browser
entities.rationale: Drawn box labeled Web Browser on the upper left representing the user interface accessing the platform.

entities.name: Web Server / Job Manager
entities.rationale: EC2 compute icon labeled WEB SERVER / JOB MANAGER hosting the web application and job management services.

entities.name: Database
entities.rationale: AWS database icon labeled DATABASE used to store and cache video metadata.

entities.name: IMF
entities.rationale: EC2 compute icon labeled IMF representing the Interoperable Master Format processing component.

entities.name: G3
entities.rationale: EC2 compute icon labeled G3 representing GPU-enabled instances running video processing workflows (Wormhole, Spacetime, Dark Energy).

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda icon labeled LAMBDA used to extract clip metadata using MediaInfo.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: AWS S3 storage icon labeled S3 storing input and output video clips.

visual_connections.description: Connection line between Web Browser and Web Server / Job Manager.
Arrow pointing from Database to Web Server representing metadata retrieval.
Arrow pointing from Job Manager to Database representing metadata storage.
Arrow pointing up from Lambda to Web Server / Job Manager.
Bidirectional arrow connecting Lambda and S3 bucket.
Line drawn from G3 wrapping under Lambda and pointing up into S3.
